-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Zendesk credentials and connectivity.

list-tickets.name: list-tickets
list-tickets.description: List Zendesk tickets with optional filters. Returns curated rows { id, subject, status, priority, requester, assignee, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: status?, priority?, assigneeId?, requesterId?, organizationId?, limit (1-100, def 30), page.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

get-ticket.name: get-ticket
get-ticket.description: Get a single Zendesk ticket by ID with full details including description, custom fields, and tags.

create-ticket.name: create-ticket
create-ticket.description: Create a new Zendesk ticket. Returns the created ticket. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: subject, description, requesterEmail?, priority?, status?, assigneeId?, tags?, customFields?.

params.subject: Ticket subject line.
params.requesterEmail: Email address of the requester. If omitted, uses the authenticated user.
params.assigneeId: User ID to assign the ticket to.
params.tags: Tags to attach to the ticket.

update-ticket.name: update-ticket
update-ticket.description: Update an existing Zendesk ticket. Only provided fields are changed. Returns the updated ticket. Params: ticketId, subject?, description?, priority?, status?, assigneeId?, tags?, customFields?.

params.subject: New subject line.
params.assigneeId: User ID to assign the ticket to.

delete-ticket.name: delete-ticket
delete-ticket.description: Delete (soft-delete) a Zendesk ticket by ID. Returns { success, ticketId }.

search-tickets.name: search-tickets
search-tickets.description: Search Zendesk tickets using Zendesk Search API. Supports query syntax (e.g. "status:open type:ticket", "assignee:me", "tags:urgent"). Returns curated results. Params: query, limit (1-100, def 30), page.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

list-ticket-comments.name: list-ticket-comments
list-ticket-comments.description: List all comments (public and internal notes) on a Zendesk ticket. Returns curated rows { id, authorId, body, public, createdAt }. Params: ticketId.

add-ticket-comment.name: add-ticket-comment
add-ticket-comment.description: Add a comment to a Zendesk ticket. Can be public (customer-visible) or internal note. Returns the updated ticket. Params: ticketId, body, public?.

params.public: Whether the comment is public (customer-visible). Default true.

add-comment-with-attachment.name: add-comment-with-attachment
add-comment-with-attachment.description: Add a comment to a Zendesk ticket with file attachments. Uses upload tokens from upload-attachment. Returns the updated ticket. Params: ticketId, body, uploadTokens?, public?.

params.public: Whether the comment is public (customer-visible). Default true.

upload-attachment.name: upload-attachment
upload-attachment.description: Upload a file attachment to Zendesk for use in ticket comments. Returns upload token. Params: filePath, fileName?.

params.filePath: Path to the file to upload.
params.fileName: Desired filename for the attachment. Defaults to basename of filePath.

get-attachment.name: get-attachment
get-attachment.description: Get details of a Zendesk attachment by ID. Returns { id, fileName, contentUrl, size, contentType, createdAt }.

list-users.name: list-users
list-users.description: List Zendesk users with optional filters. Returns curated rows { id, name, email, role, active, createdAt }. Params: role?, query?, limit (1-100, def 30), page.

params.query: Search query for user name or email.
params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

get-user.name: get-user
get-user.description: Get a single Zendesk user by ID with full details.

create-user.name: create-user
create-user.description: Create a new Zendesk user (end-user, agent, or admin). Returns the created user. Not retryable. Params: name, email, role?, phone?, organizationId?, tags?.

params.name: Full name of the user.
params.organizationId: Organization ID to associate the user with.
params.tags: Tags to attach to the user.
params.verified: Whether the user is verified. Default true for agents/admins.

update-user.name: update-user
update-user.description: Update an existing Zendesk user. Only provided fields are changed. Returns the updated user. Params: userId, name?, email?, role?, phone?, organizationId?, tags?, active?.

params.name: New full name.
params.organizationId: Organization ID to associate the user with.

list-organizations.name: list-organizations
list-organizations.description: List Zendesk organizations. Returns curated rows { id, name, domainNames, tags, createdAt }. Params: limit (1-100, def 30), page.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

get-organization.name: get-organization
get-organization.description: Get a single Zendesk organization by ID with full details including domain names and tags.

create-organization.name: create-organization
create-organization.description: Create a new Zendesk organization. Returns the created organization. Not retryable. Params: name, domainNames?, tags?.

params.name: Organization name (must be unique).
params.tags: Tags to attach to the organization.

list-views.name: list-views
list-views.description: List Zendesk views (ticket filters). Returns curated rows { id, title, active, position, createdAt }.

get-view-tickets.name: get-view-tickets
get-view-tickets.description: Get tickets from a specific Zendesk view. Returns curated ticket rows. Params: viewId, limit (1-100, def 30), page.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

list-groups.name: list-groups
list-groups.description: List Zendesk groups (ticket assignment groups). Returns curated rows { id, name, default, createdAt }.

list-triggers.name: list-triggers
list-triggers.description: List Zendesk triggers (business rules that fire on ticket events). Read-only for agents. Returns curated rows { id, title, active, position, createdAt }.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

list-automations.name: list-automations
list-automations.description: List Zendesk automations (time-based business rules). Read-only for agents. Returns curated rows { id, title, active, position, createdAt }.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

list-webhooks.name: list-webhooks
list-webhooks.description: List Zendesk webhooks (HTTP endpoints that receive real-time event notifications). Returns curated rows { id, name, status, endpoint, createdAt }.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

list-satisfaction-ratings.name: list-satisfaction-ratings
list-satisfaction-ratings.description: List Zendesk satisfaction ratings (CSAT scores). Returns curated rows { id, score, comment, ticketId, requesterId, createdAt }. Params: score?, limit (1-100, def 30), page.

params.limit: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 30.

name: Zendesk
description: Zendesk support integration — manage tickets, users, organizations, views, groups, triggers, automations, attachments, webhooks, and satisfaction ratings via the Zendesk REST API v2 with rate limiting.

changelog.notes: Create, search, and reply to support tickets, manage users, organizations, and views, and track satisfaction ratings
